paragraphs: Giddel bar Binyamin, in the name of Rabbi Yisa: Midrash Chazit, on “Behold his bed.” Shekalim, chapter 4, in the name of Rabbi Assi. Rabbi Chiyya bar Yosef said. In the name of Rav: Jerusalem Talmud, Pesachim, end of chapter Haishah; Tosafot, Sotah 31b, in the name of Jerusalem Talmud, Sotah chapter 6, halakhah 4.
